questions.q: Ar. Marangal was hired by client Magiting to gather data for his 2-storey, single-attached, 3-bedroom residence, under the multiple direct personnel expenses compensation method. Ar. Marangal’s professional fee rate is 10,000.00 PHP for 8 hours of work per day. How much will the maximum professional fee charged to client Magiting be if Ar. Marangal performed all the work himself, no other professionals were needed, and it took him 5 days to complete the project, with reimbursable expenses totaling 10,000.00 PHP?
questions.n: The calculation follows the MDPE formula: (Rate × Days × Multiplier) + Expenses, or (10,000 × 5 × 2.5) + 10,000.

questions.q: Ar. Bogart topped the licensure examinations for architects and was subsequently hired by his Aunt Tee, who supported his studies financially, to design her dream house located in an exclusive and affluent neighborhood in Metro Manila. Can Ar. Bogart offer a discount to his Aunt because she financially supported his studies?
o: Yes, if the discount is documented.
No, because it is illegal to help family.
Yes, because she is a benefactor.
No,architets are paid base on their skills not relationships
questions.n: Professional ethics dictate that compensation is a reflection of professional expertise and responsibility, not personal ties.

questions.q: Which of the following is not a method of compensation for an architect's work?
questions.n: Architectural fees must be monetary to maintain professional standards and proper legal/tax records.

questions.q: Aunt Tee did not hire you as her architect initially, as she believed you lacked experience. Instead, she hired Ar. Two to design her dream house. Later, Aunt Tee discovered that Ar. Two was a scammer and had run off with her hard-earned money. Now, Aunt Tee seeks your help with her dream house and asks you what would be a fair type of compensation, considering she lost a significant amount of money?
questions.n: This is the standard, fair method for residential design that aligns the fee with the project's magnitude.

questions.q: Aunt Tee did not hire you as her architect initially, as she believed you lacked experience. Instead, she hired Ar. Two to design her dream house. Later, Aunt Tee discovered that Ar. Two was a scammer and had run off with her hard-earned money. Now, Aunt Tee seeks your help with her dream house and wants a fair type of compensation, considering she lost a significant amount of money. Is this type of compensation the most common type of compensation?
questions.n: Percentage-based compensation remains the industry standard in the Philippines for regular design services.

questions.q: Aunt Tee did not hire you as her architect initially, as she believed you lacked experience. Instead, she hired Ar. Two to design her dream house. Later, Aunt Tee discovered that Ar. Two was a scammer and had run off with her hard-earned money. Now, Aunt Tee wants to hire you and is considering a compensation method she saw on social media, where they used a cost per square meter computation for the project cost. If Aunt Tee wants to use this similar method of computation for professional fee, what is this compensation or remuneration called?
questions.n: Unit cost compensation derives the total fee from a fixed price per unit of measurement (square meter).

questions.q: Under percentage-based compensation based on the project's construction cost, which of the following is not a consideration in determining the architect's fee?
questions.n: The fee is based on the Project Construction Cost (PCC), which excludes non-construction items like permits and land costs.

questions.q: What type of compensation is typically used when the architect's fee is based on the total construction cost of the project?
questions.n: This method directly links the fee to the magnitude of the project's physical construction.

questions.q: Which of the following is a basis for determining the professional fee of an architect when using a percentage-based compensation based on the project's construction cost?
o: either estimated PCC ,Awared PCC, Final PCC
questions.n: The fee progresses and is adjusted from the initial estimate to the winning bid and the final actual cost.

questions.q: Ar. Bogart was hired for Building Administration and Management Services in a leasing residential development. What would be the most typical type of compensation for Ar. Bogart?
questions.n: Management fees are often tied to the value of the property or the revenue it generates.

questions.q: Ar. Bogart was hired by a client to design a Two Storey 3 Bedroom Residence. The scope of the project is detailed from the start, including design, approvals, and construction schedules. The client and the architect agree on all the details of the scope, such as the number of revisions, the deadlines for design approval, and the expected construction timeline. In this case, Ar. Bogart prepares a comprehensive estimate of the work hours and overhead costs to ensure that the project is delivered on time and within budget. What type of compensation method is most appropriate for this project?
questions.n: When the scope is clearly defined and predictable, a fixed fee is the most direct and agreed-upon method.

questions.q: Ar. Bogart was hired by a client to design a Two Storey 3 Bedroom Residence. The scope of the project is detailed from the start, including design, approvals, and construction schedules. Bogart?
o: The total area of the bedrooms
The number of working drawings produced
either Lump sump from pcc or Fixed amount from estimate
questions.n: Both methods provide a guaranteed fixed amount based on the project's pre-defined parameters.

questions.q: Aunt Tingan-Ting hires you to perform pre-design services for her. What would be the best method of compensation for your work?
o: Payment Based in number of hours
questions.n: Pre-design services like research and site analysis are most accurately billed by the time spent.

questions.q: Which of the following does not belong in the list of services typically compensated using time-based fees?
questions.n: Full design services are usually percentage-based or fixed fee, not hourly.

questions.q: Ar. Bogart was hired by Aunt Tingan-ting to do an ocular inspection for a 3-storey, 5-bedroom residence in Davao City. What will Ar. Bogart use as a basis for his compensation?
o: Per diem honorarium plus reimbursable expenses
questions.n: Short-term out-of-town tasks are billed per day plus costs like travel and lodging.

questions.q: Ar. Bogart was hired by Aunt Tingan-ting to do an ocular inspection for a 3-storey, 5-bedroom residence in Davao City. Who will pay for Ar. Bogart’s plane ticket and accommodation?
o: Ar. Bogart pays from his fee
questions.n: All direct project-related expenses like travel and lodging are reimbursable by the client.

questions.q: Aunt Tingan-ting hired Ar. Bogart to design a duplex project for leasing purposes. She was impressed with Ar. Bogart's professionalism and the timely delivery of the project, so she hired him again a pre-design services of an 8-unit apartment building. What would be the best method of compensation for Ar. Bogart?
questions.n: This ensures the architect is paid for his time and reimbursed for the high volume of research data for 8 units.

questions.q: Aunt Tingan-ting hired Ar. Bogart to design a duplex project for leasing purposes. She was impressed with Ar. Bogart’s professionalism and the timely delivery of the project, so she hired him again for a pre-design services of an 8-unit apartment building. In this new project, what would be the most suitable method of compensation for Ar. Bogart?
questions.n: A single fixed amount is often the most straightforward way to bill for a specific pre-design phase.

questions.q: Aunt Tingan-Ting hired Ar. Bogart for a commercial restaurant project. She asks Ar. Bogart to first gather data, as she needs this information for the feasibility study to secure a loan from the bank. What type of compensation would benefit Ar. Bogart for this task?
o: Gratis until the loan is approved
questions.n: Gathering data is time-consuming and staff-intensive, making the Multiple Direct Personnel Expenses method highly effective.

questions.q: A large retail chain hires Ar. Bogart as their Professional Consulting Architect (PCA). The company anticipates needing professional consulting services periodically for store renovations, expansions, and other changes over the next year. They agree to a regular payment that ensures Ar. Bogart's availability whenever his services are required, though additional fees will apply for any extra work beyond the agreed scope. What type of compensation method is being used in this scenario?
questions.n: A retainer is a regular payment that guarantees the architect's availability for a client.

questions.q: Ar. Bogart is hired for a complex commercial development project. The project is dynamic, with potential changes in scope and the need for additional experimental studies to refine the design. Since the total costs are difficult to predict, Ar. Bogart agrees to a compensation method that calculates fees based on the salaries of all involved staff and applies a multiplier, along with reimbursement for specific project expenses like travel, materials, and other direct costs. What type of compensation method is being used in this scenario?
questions.n: This formula allows for flexibility in complex projects by multiplying actual staff costs by a set factor.

questions.q: Aunt Tee seeks help from Ar. Two for a single-storey, 2-bedroom residence. As part of the first phase, the site selection analysis is included under pre-design services. She asks Ar. Two for an initial meeting to discuss the future terms for the project. Before the meeting starts, Ar. Two presents a service agreement for Aunt Tee to read and sign. Did Ar. Two do the right thing?
questions.n: The initial meeting is needed to define the project scope before a contract can be drafted and signed.

questions.q: Aunt Tee seeks help from Ar. Two for a single-storey, 2-bedroom residence. As part of the first phase, the site selection analysis is included under pre-design services. She asks Ar. Two for an initial meeting to discuss the future terms for the project. After the meeting, Ar. Two drafts a service agreement for Aunt Tee. What would be the percentage of the acceptance fee for Ar. Two in the service agreement for the site selection analysis under pre-design services?
o: None, fees are only paid at the end
questions.n: A 5% acceptance fee is standard to mobilize professional services in the Philippines.

questions.q: Aunt Tee seeks help from Ar. Two for a single-storey, 2-bedroom residence. As part of the first phase, the site selection analysis is included under pre-design services. She asks Ar. Two for an initial meeting to discuss the future terms for the project. After the meeting, Ar. Two drafts a service agreement for Aunt Tee. What would be the amount of the acceptance fee for Ar. Two in the service agreement for the site selection analysis under pre-design services if the agreed professional fee is 120,000.00 PHP and the estimated total project cost is 2,400,000.00 PHP?
questions.n: 5% of 120,000.00 is exactly 6,000.00 PHP.
